designSummary: Narrative synthesis in three strands with structured tables; no pooling across strands or adherence methods.
sampleSize: Not a sample: all eligible reports found are included. The search reported 19 hits for the core query; with the library's broader searches about 600 titles are expected, which one pharmacist can screen in about 20 hours, leaving time for extraction of about 30 reports.
primaryAnalysis: Harms strand: table of unplanned toxicity admissions and severe toxicity by study design; where two or more trials report the same outcome and time point, a risk ratio with its interval is shown for each, without pooling historical comparisons.
secondaryAnalysis: Adherence strand tabulated by measurement method; dose intensity next to harms as a balancing measure; time and money strand: pharmacist hours per patient scaled to 480 patients a year (about 1,250 hours at 2.6 hours each) and reported cost ranges, each with assumptions, never netted against effects; patient views summarised narratively; who is not covered listed by age, living situation, distance and language.
missingData: Outcomes not reported are recorded as not reported; authors are not contacted within the timeline.
software: Spreadsheet extraction form with a strand field; tables produced from it.
overfittingGuards: No pooling across adherence measurement methods
Cost ranges never converted into a single net saving
summary: Three separate strands with tables; time scaled to the centre's volume; no combined figure.
